I believe I’ve solved the GTA coin riddle with a fairly high degree of certainty. Why I switched to this coin today:
Out of the 10 or 15 instances of DacityCoin leaked so far in trailers and footage, ZERO of those instances have used the word “Dacity” on its own or a cashtag at all. Before this, with the plane only I thought maybe there wasn’t enough space on the side of the plane to seperate the 2 words, but now it’s quite conclusive to me. ***Videogames and brands in general typically repeat the same imagery exactly as is. They will probably even avoid using a Cashtag $ all together based on the fact that we haven’t seen a $ in all of the instances of the coin in game so far. Also, people outside of finance aren’t even familiar with cashtags***
Lastly, AudaCity is in fact, the meme itself and inseparable from DacityCoin. “Quit your job, sell your house, move to AudaCity” is the literal slogan printed on the parachute. Audacity is a parody of influencer/cryptobro culture. AudaCity will likely play a giant role in the story given how many instances we’ve seen already in the small amount of footage so far. AudaCity is also a sick name and the other one trades like it’s being farmed. It feels much better to use the exact lettering that we’ve now seen validated dozens of times by Rockstar. I’m all in because billion dollar narratives are rare asf and I think this is our best shot at true PvE. GLHF🙏🩷

comment.comment:
In my initial thesis, I mentioned I wanted to see DACITY win. 

As time has gone on and I’ve mulled it over more- what should win is the correct tokenization, above all else. 

It’s take two and the GTA developers that decided to call it ‘DacityCoin’ with no space. It’s not up to the trenches to make their own version. It’s gotta be 1:1 with the game. 

I don’t believe there will be any way to trade/buy memes in GTA6. There is no point. So there will not be ticker. 

The currency of AudaCity in GTA 6 is ‘DacityCoin’ no matter which way you look at it. 

Audacity is the city/company/brand. The currency is DacityCoin. 

We’re not here to be creative, we’re here to create a tradeable version of the memecoin in the biggest game of all time.
